NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: Consider the following data. (i) $\ce{2Al(s) + 6HCl(aq) -> Al2Cl6(aq) + 3H2(g)} + 1200\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$ (ii) $\ce{H2(g) + Cl2(g) -> 2HCl(g)} + 164\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$. (iii) $\ce{HCl(g) + aq -> HCl(aq)} + 83\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$. (iv) $\ce{Al2Cl6(s) + aq -> Al2Cl6(aq)} + 663\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$ The enthalpy of formation of anhydrous solid $\ce{Al2Cl6}$ is :
stem.hi: निम्नलिखित आँकड़ों पर विचार कीजिए। (i) $\ce{2Al(s) + 6HCl(aq) -> Al2Cl6(aq) + 3H2(g)} + 1200\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$ (ii) $\ce{H2(g) + Cl2(g) -> 2HCl(g)} + 164\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$। (iii) $\ce{HCl(g) + aq -> HCl(aq)} + 83\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$। (iv) $\ce{Al2Cl6(s) + aq -> Al2Cl6(aq)} + 663\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$ निर्जल ठोस $\ce{Al2Cl6}$ की विरचन एन्थैल्पी है :

feynman.en: Heat written on the product side is heat given out, so each $\Delta H$ is negative. Combine the equations so that everything cancels except $\ce{2Al(s) + 3Cl2(g) -> Al2Cl6(s)}$.
feynman.hi: उत्पाद की ओर लिखी ऊष्मा मुक्त ऊष्मा है, अतः प्रत्येक $\Delta H$ ऋणात्मक है। समीकरणों को ऐसे जोड़िए कि $\ce{2Al(s) + 3Cl2(g) -> Al2Cl6(s)}$ के अतिरिक्त सब कट जाए।
